goal: Separate fatal system and I/O errors from consensus validation state
Stop non-validating storage functions from relying on validation state out-parameters
agreement: Disputed: broad debate on error-handling mechanisms across validation and the kernel
Concept approval for explicit, value-based error propagation (optout21, hodlinator, l0rinc, arejula27)
Contested objection: returning expected risks chain splits and slows IBD vs exceptions (purpleKarrot)
Contested objection: flattening expected results into booleans invites silent fatal failures (alexanderwiederin)
Unaddressed objection: adding FatalError broadens kernel maintenance scope (arejula27)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it cleanly delineates kernel library error boundaries and the public C API
Establishes a dedicated fatal error type for library consumers rather than conflating it with validation

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it eliminates an architectural hazard conflating fatal system faults with consensus invalidity
Unblocks cleaner validation method signatures across core chain state operations
